newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine January fiscal deficit $418.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine January fiscal deficit $418.3 mln.

text.p: Argentina's fiscal deficit for January, without privatization income but including the transfer of provincial pension funds to central government, was $418.3 million, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.

Stripping out the negative impact of the transfer of the provincial pension funds, the fiscal shortfall for the month was $276.1 million, the ministry said. This compares with a shortfall of $482.1 million in January last year.
Argentina's stand-by agreement with the International Monetary Fund includes a $3.0 billion budget deficit target for 1997, or $4.5 billion including the provincial pension fund transfer.

The IMF-agreed target for the first quarter of this year is $1.04 billion, or $1.64 billion including the cost to the central government of taking on loss-making provincial state pension funds under the so-called "Federal Pact."
